panel_1.title: How can you find a product on our trading platform? Let's explore a few methods!
panel_1.text_1: Through the catalog. Our catalog contains almost all types of products, and you can find the products you want! We constantly update our catalog. If you have any recommendations for the catalog or if we missed any product type, contact our operators — we will add that product type to the catalog for you!
panel_1.text_2: Searching by image. This method is very accurate and convenient! You upload a product image, and within 10 seconds, you’ll receive the prices and information for that product. The image search function is located before the search bar on our platform. In this section, you can upload your image or an image taken from the Internet.
panel_1.text_3: Searching by link. With this function, you can find the exact product you want using a link from Taobao, Tmall, or 1688 trading platforms.

panel_2.title_1: How can you find a product on our trading platform? Let's explore a few methods!
panel_2.title_4: Pointer to the table requesting email address and password
panel_2.text_1: To register, we need your email address!
panel_2.text_2: You will register by following the procedure shown in the image
panel_2.text_3: After logging into our platform, navigate to the section shown in the image
panel_2.text_4: When you enter this section, the login and registration buttons will appear. To register, click the registration button.
panel_2.text_5: After clicking the registration button, there are two types of registration available
panel_2.text_6: 1. You independently enter your email address and set your password
panel_2.text_7: 2. Register via Google. If you have a Google email, clicking the button will automatically register you for our site without requiring any password or login.
panel_2.text_8: 3. After registering, enter your name, surname, and the phone number you use to start shopping!

Custom.title: How to make a payment on our trading platform?
Custom.text_1: After you select the desired product, you will proceed to the checkout page. There, you will be provided with information about your selected products and the total payment amount. You will need to transfer the payment amount to the provided card number. Payme, Click, Uzum, and any banking apps will assist you in making the payment.
Custom.text_2: After transferring the money to our card, take a photo of the receipt and upload it in the receipt upload section on our platform. Once you've uploaded the receipt, your payment and order will be reviewed and confirmed from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
Custom.text_3: On our platform, you can make payments not only with a plastic card but also in cash. To do this, select the products, add them to your cart, and come to our offices where you can hand over the money. We will issue a receipt and immediately place your order. Currently, our offices are only available in Kokand and Tashkent.

Transport.text_6: If the order weight exceeds 1 kg, each additional kilogram or gram will be charged at this rate.

About.welcome: WELCOME to the OPTOM-ALL shopping platform!
About.partnership: The OPTOMALL platform has signed a cooperation agreement with the Chinese giant trading platforms. On the OPTOMALL platform, you can make purchases directly from taobao, 1688 and Chinese factories in the national currency of Uzbekistan at a wholesale price!
About.features: Simply put, you can search, choose and get product information through our platform, and even use our platform for free translator service to reduce the cost of products and order. These include production equipment from simple fabric enters.
About.reliability: We are your reliable partner in China. Choice and payment from you, purchase, inspection and delivery from us! Our team has been working with China for 13 years. Our platform has several warehouses in China, has its warehouse in almost all major cities.
About.safety: More than 25 professional employees work on our platform to ensure that your product arrives safely, in good quality and without damage.
